note: Derived from ltx25_i2v_2stage by workflows/build_a2v.py: stage 1's empty audio latent is replaced by the encoded narration (LTXVAudioVAEEncode), which the graph then freezes as the audio half of the AV latent. `audio` is the uploaded WAV's name; the narration is timed and padded host-side (research 2.2), so there are no start/duration params here. The video length still comes from `frames`, and it has to match what the audio encodes to.
